item.description: The South American Coati, or Ring-tailed Coati is a species of coati from South America.

item.title: Dhole
item.description: The dhole (Cuon alpinus) is a species of canid native to Southeast Asia. It is the only extant member of the genus Cuon, which differs from Canis by the reduced number of molars and greater number of teats.

item.title: Kodiak Bear
item.description: They are the largest brown bear subspecies, and are comparable in size to polar bears. That makes Kodiak bears and polar bears the two largest members of the bear family, although polar bears tend to be longer and stand taller.
